name: workflow
description: WorkFlow — Quan ly cong viec ca nhan + CRM khach hang B2B

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @workflow/contracts && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @workflow/contracts && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @workflow/contracts && npm test -w server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @workflow/contracts && npm run build -w client && node e2e/prepare.mjs && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:ui && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
